sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Disable AI
Turns off Sparky, Walmart's AI assistant, and the AI features on item and search pages.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hide card offers
Removes Walmart's banners and prompts for the OnePay debit card, its credit cards, and OnePay Later.
Hide creator videos
Removes the "Featured in videos" creator sections and video carousels.
Hide device identifiers
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Hide prompts and pop-ups
Hides the prompts and pop-ups you choose in the patch options.
Hide sponsored listings
Removes sponsored products from Walmart's search results and category pages, and turns off sponsored carousels, banners, and video.
Hide Walmart+ promotions
Removes Walmart+ sign-up banners, free-trial offers, splashes, and the auto-playing membership video.

sources.label: R2bEEaton Walmart
sources.author: R2bEEaton Walmart
patch_list: Default Lists Tab
Opens the 'Lists' tab by default when tapping 'My Items' instead of the 'Reorder' tab.
Find Item for Linked Items
Restores the 'Find item' button on linked shopping list items so you can link a different product.
Flash Everywhere
Adds a dedicated 'Flash tag' sibling pill button next to Aisle indicators throughout the app to illuminate electronic shelf tags directly.
Real-Time Stock & Inventory Display
Displays real-time in-store stock availability badges on list and checklist items (e.g. In Stock, Low Stock / Only X left, Out of Stock).
Remove Shop
Removes the Shop tab entirely from the bottom navigation bar and opens to My Items by default.
Route My List
Adds a 'Plan my route' map icon to the Walmart 'Shop in-store' checklist screen that opens Walmart's own in-store map with every list item's aisle pinned at once.

sources.label: Walmart app Morphe patch for removing annoyances
sources.author: Ron Walmart
patch_list: Disable automatic store mode
Stops the store mode sheet from popping up on its own when you open the app in a store. Location, store-specific pricing, the in-store search filter and the store mode banner/button still work.
